#!/usr/bin/env bash
# A perf job excludes every other perf or build job on this VM.
set -euo pipefail
[[ $# -gt 0 ]]
if [[ ${CALTERNAL_PERF_HELD:-0} == 1 ]]; then
 echo 'perf-lock.sh must be invoked outside build-slot.sh' >&2
 exit 2
fi
exec flock --exclusive --close /var/lock/calternal-perf.lock \
 flock --exclusive --close /tmp/calternal-build-slot.1 \
 env CALTERNAL_PERF_HELD=1 "$@"
